hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push'; then if [ -z "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "PR not created: set GH_TOKEN in .claude/settings.json env to auto-create PRs after git push."}'; exit 0; fi; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && ! GH_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" gh pr view "$branch" --repo Frenor/rode-kors-felt --json number >/dev/null 2>&1; then GH_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" gh pr create --repo Frenor/rode-kors-felt --fill --base main --head "$branch" && echo '{"systemMessage": "PR created on GitHub."}' || true; fi; fi
